text: What is AI skunk works at Nor Eastern and its post-graduate cousin humanitarians AI? I have been a part of and have also led AI skunk works under the guidance of professor Brown. This experience gave me the opportunity to collaborate with students from various departments at Northeastern. We created a dynamic environment where we could research, innovate and implement projects in the field of AI. I've watched AI skunk works grow from 300 students to over 940. It has not only helped students enhance their technical skills but also develop interpersonal and management abilities within the organization. We establish multiple research groups focused on topics like causal inference, reinforcement

Learning, Kaggle, and explainable AI. These groups meet weekly, fostering collaboration and project development. Through these projects, students, including myself, gained valuable skills to enhance their resumes. This experience directly contributed to securing part-time and full-time job opportunities. That is a major step forward in any professional career. In my 2.5 years at Northeastern, I have not come across another organization quite like AI Skunk Works. It is uniquely dedicated to skill development. It offers students not just peer connections, but also industry exposure. Professor Brown has played a pivotal role mentoring students one-on-one and guiding projects. He has helped students share their work publicly through medium articles, ebooks, and research

Publications. This is what sets AI skunk works apart. And under Professor Brown's leadership, I truly believe it will continue to make a lasting impact. Humanitarians AI is a 501c3 nonprofit that allows fellows to continue doing research, taking workshops and learning postgraduation by coding for a cause and continuing STEM AI research. This allows people to continue to do research to stop the OPT clock while continuing to learn until they get a great post-graduate job offer. For mentors concerned that humanitarians AI will leave their research projects, the fellows let us know at least a month beforehand that they are taking that next step in life and another AI fellow

Comes into shadow to take over the project. Please consider donating to humanitarians AI or if you are a current student joining AI skunk works. Yours Abishek AI researcher and former president at AI skunk works.
